note: Pre-registered pass lines. Committed before P-010 starts and before any holdout or post-ship outcome data was read (D-013 rule 3(a)). holdout-replay.test.ts and delivery-mode.test.ts read lines only from this file. Editing a line after its data is seen voids it (D-008).

flagsPerDay.definition: mean over the window's UTC days of newly flagged distinct items; an item flagged on several days counts once, on its first day

comparability.onFailure: historical line counts as no data; the check stays list-only

c.note: Sanity check only: the rule was chosen while looking at these days (lines from items done 2026-10-14..2026-10-30, flags over 2026-10-31..2026-11-13).

d.realLabel: within 14 days: dropped, or reassigned by an actor other than the holder, or judged stuck by a lineage-excluded responder's recorded consult answer

stuckJudgmentQuestion: Reading only this timeline, is item <id> stuck: no result and no credible path to one without a change of approach or an owner decision? Answer stuck or not stuck and cite timeline entries.

repeatedMiss.action: coord:ask-owner with at least 2 options instead of re-arming a third time

ruleChangeAfterMiss: evaluated on new post-ship days, never on the holdout
